correctness.rationale: PASS. Minimality in subsequence order is equivalent to all single deletions destroying at least one target. For A=0^m1^m and B=1^m0^m, any minimal W must be union-covered by chosen embeddings; disjoint embeddings can be replaced with intersecting embeddings, contradicting deletion-minimality. Shared positions must all have one symbol, since the order of any shared zero and one is opposite in A and B. After complementing, exactly 2m zeros straddle a central positive ones run of length g; extremal deletion arguments force j=m-g ones on each side, so W=P1^(m-j)Q, with P/Q each having m zeros and j ones. The forced boundary zero leaves C(m+j-1,j)^2 per complement orientation; j=0..m-1, otherwise no minimal words. Dominated geometric tail (ratio <=1/4^k) and Stirling give T_m~16^m/(6 pi m). Independent exhaustive subsequence and deletions agrees for 24 (m,L) strata m=1..4. Finite m<=4 is not the infinite proof.
